universe_claim: server file universe; not all US exchanges
eligibility_rule: metadata instrumentType=EQUITY; >=200 valid adjusted-close rows before 2022-01-03; last valid row >= 2026-10-30
warmup: all available rows before start; valid adjusted close=close*adjclose/close
ohlc_adjustment: all OHLC multiplied by adjclose/close; volume unadjusted
strategies: see strategy_metrics.csv; Coin_Trade US formulas independently ported from rs_kr_strats defaults per main spec
cross_market_caveat: US source fills at next close; KR source fills next open. S1 US averages 0/7/14 phase equity returns; KR uses one start-anchored phase. Cross-market raw return comparisons are limited.
execution: offline one-off read-only data container; no network, no service restart, no trading/orders
